critical_code_review_comments: services.py PUT /services/{sid} uses body.category directly (no fallback to 'General') while POST falls back to 'General' — minor inconsistency; not a bug because ServiceIn already defaults category='General' at Pydantic layer, but worth aligning to POST's `body.category or 'General'` for defense-in-depth.

services.py list_service_categories returns strings but relies on db.services.distinct() which returns whatever value was stored — no lowercasing/normalization, so 'hair' and 'Hair' would appear as separate categories. Consider normalizing category on write (title-case) or on read (dedupe case-insensitively).

manage/services.tsx additionalPrice validation only fires if the field is non-empty; empty string is coerced to Number('') = 0 (fine). But `Number.isFinite(ap)` on line 74 is checked only inside the guard — when additionalPrice is empty string, ap = NaN → still Number.isFinite(ap) is false, but the guard is skipped due to falsy additionalPrice. That works but is fragile; a clearer implementation would be `const ap = additionalPrice.trim() ? Number(additionalPrice) : 0`.
